summary: Tenant 'snooze' window affinity reset mixes model variants and returns intermediate outputs
description:
Issue summary: Customer reports intermittent mixing of model outputs (expected variant A but receiving partial outputs from variant B) for a subset of requests during their configured tenant 'snooze' window. The mixing appears transient and correlated with scheduled background metrics aggregation that runs at the same minute as the snooze window end.

Impact: Affected tenant seeing degraded output consistency for ~0.2% of requests during their nightly snooze window (00:00-00:10 UTC). Some responses include tokens or formatting from the older model variant which the tenant had explicitly pinned. Potential billing discrepancy suspected due to fallback to quantized variant at same time.

Environment: Production, us-east region, enterprise tenant with dedicated route and pin to open-llama-3b-v2.
steps_to_reproduce:
1) Tenant has a pinned route to open-llama-3b-v2 with an active snooze window 00:00-00:10 UTC.
2) Send mixed synchronous chat+streaming requests spanning 23:59:50-00:00:30 UTC.
3) Observe that 1 in ~500 requests returns a response that contains truncation/format artifacts tied to open-llama-3b-v2-quant variant.
4) Re-run during non-snooze time and the issue does not reproduce.
logs:
Edge proxy trace: cookie-rewrite at 00:00:05 UTC (edge-proxy-12)
Orchestrator: prewarm-sweep started 00:00:04 UTC (orch-3), async metrics flush queued 00:00:04.1 UTC
Serving runtime: kvcache warm assign for model open-llama-3b-v2-quant on node gpu-9 at 00:00:05.8 UTC
Request traces (sample): request-id=nx-9f2a: pinned-model header present but cohort_token missing on a few requests; fallback route executed to quant variant; latency 92ms vs usual 48ms.
Billing logs: two requests recorded usage under quant variant SKUs at 00:00:05 UTC for tenant nimbledocs-acc-21.
investigation_notes:
Hypothesis 1: The 'snooze' window lifecycle handler performs an atomic state transition that momentarily clears cohort_token or tenant-affinity before the orchestrator completes prewarm allocation; this leads the edge to treat the request as unrouted and fall back to the fastest available compatible variant (quant).
Hypothesis 2: Async metrics aggregation triggers a small reconfiguration message to the orchestrator that races with the snooze end hook, causing temporary epoch/route metadata mismatch between control plane snapshot and edge cache.
Telemetry examined: control-plane snapshot versions show sequence gap between 00:00:03.9 and 00:00:05.2. Edge cookie rotation logs indicate TTL reset events at 00:00:04.9 for the tenant cookie namespace.
Reproduced in staging by co-locating metrics-aggregator cron at same second; reproduction rate ~0.18%.
Related code paths: route-snooze-handler, edge-affinity-reconcile, orchestrator-prewarm-sweep.
comments: 2026-03-11 09:12 - Support (Aisha): Customer reported mixed outputs during their scheduled snooze. Provided request ids and sample responses. Marked P1 due to enterprise SLA.
2026-03-11 09:45 - Eng (Jonah): Pulled traces and saw cookie TTL reset at snooze boundary. Raising orchestrator attention; tagging orch on Slack #support-orch.

2026-03-11 11:03 - Orch (Lena Kim): Noted prewarm sweep runs on a one-minute window; we see a metadata snapshot update that can overwrite edge cache when sequence numbers mismatch. Adding temporary mitigation: jitter prewarm cron for affected tenants.
2026-03-12 07:29 - Support (Aisha): Customer confirms issue continues at low rate overnight; provided a list of 28 request ids from 00:00-00:06 UTC across last 10 nights.

2026-03-13 14:02 - Eng (Jonah): Deployed hotfix: edge now rejects control-plane snapshot updates with non-monotonic seq numbers within 5s of snooze-end events. Observed no mixed responses in canary run last night (n=120k requests).
resolution:
Mitigation applied: orchestrator prewarm cron jittered and edge snapshot apply hardened to avoid non-monotonic sequence updates within the snooze handoff window. Hotfix PR merged: github.com/redwood-inference/orchestrator/pull/1892.
Customer workaround: move snooze window by +15s (temporary) or schedule metrics aggregation away from snooze boundary.
Current status: mitigation in prod canary for tenant cohort, monitoring for 72h. No full rollback required.
followup_actions:
1) Postmortem runbook: add check to snooze-handler to block background snapshot applies for 10s after window end.
2) Engineering story to add a control-plane seq monotonicity gate and improved telemetry for cohort_token lifecycle (ETA 2 weeks).
3) Inform Billing ops to reconcile two quant-variant SKUs charged during impacted timestamps and issue credit if necessary (owner: Finance Ops).
4) Notify customer via CSM with summary and expected timeline.
